scope: One persisted qualitative brick/mortar shader adjustment in the Knoy source library and dedicated builder; no geometry, placement, floor, roof, PV, door, fixture, stair, or master edits.
review_finding_addressed: R15 remained below threshold; reviewer still described the masonry as brighter/more regular than the Purdue red-brown brick reference and the mortar grid as conspicuous. R16 slightly deepens the brick palette and reduces mortar contrast/estimated width.

material.name: KNOY_Purdue_Red_Brick

source_basis.supports: Qualitative red/brown masonry and lighter joints on one identifiable Knoy entrance view.
source_basis.limits: Undated, single perspective photo; no color calibration or known exposure. Does not establish measured material color, brick/mortar dimensions, bond specification, or facade-wide assignment.

source_basis.supports: Qualitative entrance brick bond and contrast from a second view.
source_basis.limits: Uncalibrated perspective image; shader values remain visual estimates.

material.limits: Values are render estimates only. The retained regular running-bond pattern and dimensions are not a measured masonry specification; no per-face assignment or facade cadence was changed.

findings.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
findings.record: UA 141, Knoy Hall of Technology records; 1984; open for research; described as construction information and a floorplan.
findings.result: The online finding aid exposes descriptive metadata but no digital plan or elevation scans. It is a promising physical/in-person archival lead, not geometry evidence inspected for this revision.

findings.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
findings.record: UA 62 finding aid describes 1985 Technology Building/Knoy construction photos, a graphic rendering and a separate 1987 building photo set.
findings.result: The finding aid is public; the described photographs/rendering were not exposed as linked image scans in the source record. No facade measurements can be extracted from the finding aid itself.

findings.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
findings.record: Official building history says Knoy was an early Purdue solar-powered building and had photovoltaic arrays on its roof.
findings.result: This supports historical roof-array presence only. It does not establish the current array's position, count, support geometry or persistence, so no PV geometry was changed.

findings.record: Index lists 'Technology Building ready for student use; landscaping, laboratories near completion (Photos)', Exponent Newspapers, 1984-08-22, p. 6B.
findings.result: The index entry is discoverable but the page image was not linked from the search results; it was not treated as a viewed photo or geometry source.

findings.provider: ConstructConnect project listing for Purdue Knoy G007 lab refresh
findings.record: Project page describes the 2024 Knoy G007 lab refresh and lists plans/specifications as subscription documents.
findings.result: No openly accessible drawings were found; no details were inferred from the project listing.

findings.record: The 2018 Gateway sheet labels a typical Levels 2-4 plan and shows floor-to-floor datum intervals under 'Existing Knoy Elevations'.
findings.result: The elevation panel contains datum/dimension lines rather than traceable facades. It supports the previously documented level spacing but does not resolve exterior cadence or roof form.

additional_source_search.conclusion: No newly accessible source gives calibrated facade elevations, current roof equipment configuration, or complete as-built circulation. Accordingly, uncertain exterior/roof/interior geometry and GIS alignment were not changed.
